decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To prevent the accumulation of unimplemented planning permissions and to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended) and to meet the requirements of Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and to meet the requirements of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with: 
DRAWING: P26151-00-01-LCH (LUX CONTOURS - HORIZONTAL 01); WALL TEMPLATE - 10% SCALE, 82 WANDSWORTH HIGH ST; LOCATION PLAN, PLANNING PORTAL REFERENCE: PP-14547422V2. P26151 - 00 - 01 (LAYOUT DRAWING - ELEVATION)

DOCUMENTS: 
-Design Report - 82 Wandsworth High Street, prepared by: Ecological -Lighting Solutions; reference: P26151; dated: 17/07/2026.
-Luminaire Schedule - 82 Wandsworth High Street, prepared by: Ecological -Lighting Solutions; reference: P26151; dated: 17/07/2026.
-PLANNING STATEMENT - PROPOSED EXTERNAL ILLUMINATION; Site: 82 Wandsworth High Street, SW18; prepared by: Global Street Art.

Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - The external lighting hereby approved shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the recommendations, specifications and mitigation measures contained within the submitted Lighting Design Report prepared by Ecological Lighting Solutions (Project Ref. P26151, dated 17 July 2026), the approved lighting layout drawing, and any associated lux contour plans.

The approved lighting scheme shall include, but not be limited to:

luminaires with a maximum correlated colour temperature (CCT) of 2700K.
installation in accordance with the approved mounting positions, tilt angles, shielding and beam directions.
operation via automatic timers with illumination between dusk and turned off no later than 23:00 hours daily.
maintenance of all lighting controls, shielding and mitigation measures for the lifetime of the development.
no uplighting or upward light spill.
no illumination of adjacent riparian vegetation or habitats associated with the River Wandle corridor.
The approved lighting scheme shall be retained and operated thereafter in accordance with these details for the lifetime of the advertisement. No additional lighting, alterations to the approved luminaires, increases in illumination levels, changes to colour temperature, operating hours, mounting arrangements or shielding shall take place unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect commuting and foraging bats and maintain the ecological function of the River Wandle wildlife corridor, in accordance with Policies LP53 and LP55 of the Wandsworth Local Plan, the National Planning Policy Framework, the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended), and the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.

Condition : 5 - Informative: The applicant is reminded that the approved lighting scheme relies upon the mitigation measures and assumptions contained within the submitted ecological and lighting assessments. Any future alteration to the approved lighting equipment, illumination levels, colour temperature, shielding, mounting arrangement or hours of operation may require further ecological assessment and written approval from the Local Planning Authority due to the site's proximity to the River Wandle wildlife corridor and associated bat habitat.
description: Installation of external lighting to illuminate existing hand-painted mural on the flank wall.
